items.label: Tips
items.value: Our chair leg protectors are available in several sizes! Extra Small Size fits round leg 9/16"-13/16" (15-20mm), Small Size fits round leg 13/16"-1"(20-25mm), Medium Size fits round leg 1"-1 3/16"（25-30mm), Large Size fits round leg 1 4/16"-1 6/16"（32-36 mm). Please measure the size before purchase. Please reach out to us if there are any defects or missing parts when you receive them. We will solve your problem within 24 hours.

items.label: Upgrade Chair Leg Floor Protectors
items.value: With 360° fully wrapped felt bottom design and thickening silicone furniture legs caps covers. Improved chair leg floor protectors provide a superior fit on chair legs and increased wear resistance. Enjoy a longer life and improved floor protection with this enhanced design.

items.label: Scratch-Resistant & Noise Reduction
items.value: Easy to take in and off. Our felt furniture pads are designed to protect wood floors, hardwood, and tiles from scratches while reducing the terrible noise caused by furniture legs moving across tiles or hard floors like marble.

items.label: Not Easy to Split & Fall Off
items.value: Crafted from quality TPE, Meldel silicone chair leg floor protectors feature tightly pressed felt and silicone, ensuring durability and stretchability. This material provides a firm grip on chair legs, effectively preventing shifting or detachment.

items.label: Wide Range of Use
items.value: Meldel chair leg protectors are good for hardwood floors, tile, vinyl, marble, carpet, and other surfaces. It will protect your floors from scratches and scuffs by chair legs. These extra small chair leg floor protectors are for kitchen chairs, dining chair legs, coffee chair legs, bar stools, and metal chair legs.

items.value: Bed, Bench, Cabinet, Chair, Sofa, Stool, Table
